briefdescription.para: Parses GIF binary stream metadata — canvas dimensions, per-frame positions, disposal methods, and delays.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the raw GIF bytes.

simplesect.para: A GifMetadata with isValid = true and at least one frame on success; an empty/invalid struct on failure.

briefdescription.para: File-scope GIF metadata parser shared by all platform ImageDecode translation units.

detaileddescription.para: Included directly by ImageDecode.cpp, ImageDecodeMac.mm, and ImageDecodeWin.cpp. All definitions are static — each including TU gets its own copy. This is intentional: the parser carries no mutable state and the structs are small.
